name: Amma
bio: Amma, born Lauren Amma Keen, is a British singer-songwriter and music producer from South London. Known for her soulful vocals and emotionally honest songwriting, she has written music for artists including FLO and released her debut album, Middle Child (2026).

credits.title: RAYE Live at Montreux Jazz Festival
credits.overview: Marking the opening of the 60th edition of the Montreux Jazz Festival, RAYE invites a host of international pop stars to join her on stage for an evening of music.
